scope: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's conditional conservative outer transfer at kappa=1/20000000. Reviewed all10 files, the epsilon=1/40 extension of PR2287, exact-K and nonadjacent layouts, signed packing/sign extension, both source-normalization factors, disk margins, exact carry output and seven strict cost gaps. Normal/optimized checks pass264 polynomial products,32 rounded convolutions,16608 CRT records,285 recovery pairs and compressed large-parameter witnesses. Matched frozen source06-08 and published Gaussian/prime interfaces; proof dependencies2234/2250/2287 are exact-head/hash bound. Accepted as a written conditional composition, retaining named callee and analytic premises; tests do not execute Gaussian routines or the full selected suppliers, and no unconditional/formal multiplication theorem or selected frontier change follows. Harvey,van der Hoeven,Philipp,Douglas Colkitt and retained selected-supplier contributors credited.
review_details: Reduced epsilon preserves the explicit long-record, spacing, row-reserve and guard hypotheses, while the stopped-depth exponents are unchanged.
Synthetic convolution uses division by r and M then exact M scaling; source recovery retains two S factors and widens signed words before the inverse layout.
Gaussian scalar routines and the baseline O(n log n) multiplier are retained external premises; no circular invocation of a faster multiplier.
Prime interval, alpha/theta domain, phase/chirp permutations and seven margins matched the frozen source and the author-hosted Harvey-van der Hoeven manuscript.
Finite layout models and Python exact-product backend verify interfaces only, not tape complexity or an executable full analytic multiplier.
